author: Kishor GC
review_text: I have never seen such a terrible payment system in Nepal. Neither the security nor the customer care service is satisfactory. There are countless glitches during payments. It's disgraceful for Nepal to still have such a poor payment system in the market. This should either be banned or significantly improved. I'm just fed up with eSewa, even though I only use it for small transactions.
